items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: I put Russ there, I went to show and I came back. Billy DeWolf... Billy DeWolf looks down at the pit and he tells that huge audience... 'it is certainly a pleasure to see Johnny Dread back in the pit.'

ctx.x: Well I was a leader. So I put Russ there, I went to show and I came back. Billy DeWolf, Billy DeWolf. You've heard of him?
